newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Mobile limit up at midday.
newsitem.headline: Korea Mobile limit up at midday.

text.p: Shares in Korea Mobile Telecom Corp rose in Wednesday's morning trade to their upper limit of 577,000 won, up 32,000, on buying ahead of next month's foreign shareholding expansion, brokers said.

"Korea Mobile is attractive because it is expected to become a target of foreign buying when the limit is raised. In addition, its share price has declined recently and it's seen as relatively cheap," said Hyundai Securities' analyst Lee Sang-koo.
The foreign shareholdings limit will be expanded to 20 percent on October 1 from the current 18 percent.
